name: Harmony Speaker
description: The elected voice of the Harmony Enclaves, who holds the Atlas coalition together one treaty at a time.
role: A principal figure of the macro lore; the voice of Atlas coexistence.
voice: Warm, tired and stubborn; always negotiating.

greeting.text: Sit, if you came to talk. Everyone who comes here wants something, and most leave with half.
The coalition holds because nobody gets everything. Remember that when you trade.
